verdict.rationale: Marqeta's Core API documents card creation, card state transitions, transaction retrieval, and velocity and authorization spend controls, which an agent can drive programmatically. An official MCP server lets AI agents query a designated set of Core API endpoints, and that page lists virtual card issuance, spend controls and transaction intelligence. Missing for 10: evidence of scoped or least-privilege agent credentials, an explicit balance-read endpoint or MCP tool, clarity on whether the MCP server can write (it is described as querying data), and independent hands-on corroboration.
